newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine consumer prices fall 0.2 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Argentine consumer prices fall 0.2 pct in November.

text.p: Argentine consumer prices fell 0.2 pct in November versus deflation of 0.2 percent in the same month of 1995, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
Wholesale prices also fell, registering deflation of 0.8 percent versus deflation of 0.2 percent in November last year.
The November consumer price figure compares with 0.5 percent inflation in October and takes consumer inflation figure to 0.4 percent for the last 12 months.
Argentina has registered consumer deflation five months this year, with another two months showing zero inflation.
November's wholesale deflation compares with October's 0.5 percent rise in wholesale prices, while wholesale inflation was 2.5 percent over the past 12 months.
